section:
# ---- 層契約(段 4 の段 society の木の決まり。元は tools/pkgmove/contracts.toml・`python tools/pkgmove/cli.py contracts --stage society` が作る。手で直さない)----
[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "shibuya"
include_external_packages = false

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "layers: census > economy > engine > (perception | llm) > (world | agents) > core > manifest"
type = "layers"
layers = [
  "shibuya.census",
  "shibuya.engine",
  "shibuya.perception | shibuya.llm",
  "shibuya.agents",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "llm は world/agents を import しない(mock LLM が成立する)"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
  "shibuya.llm",
]
forbidden_modules = [
  "shibuya.agents",
  "shibuya.perception",
  "shibuya.engine",
  "shibuya.census",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "build は実行時に import されない"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
  "shibuya.agents",
  "shibuya.perception",
  "shibuya.llm",
  "shibuya.engine",
  "shibuya.census",
]
forbidden_modules = [
  "shibuya.build",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "〔段 4 の途中の決まり〕1 層(§1-2 の順。下から上と、`|` の兄弟の間を読まない)"
type = "layers"
layers = [
  "shibuya.world.laws",
  "shibuya.mind | shibuya.act | shibuya.society",
  "shibuya.world.body",
  "shibuya.world.model | shibuya.world.things | shibuya.economy",
  "shibuya.world.facts | shibuya.world.ledger",
  "shibuya.foundation",
]
ignore_imports = [
  "shibuya.engine.calendar2.layer -> shibuya.llm.mock",
  "shibuya.engine.events.body -> shibuya.engine.tools.record",
  "shibuya.engine.poi_target -> shibuya.engine.chooser",
  "shibuya.engine.relations -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.engine.resolve -> shibuya.engine.change_detect",
  "shibuya.engine.resolve -> shibuya.engine.resume",
  "shibuya.engine.resolve -> shibuya.engine.state_hashes",
  "shibuya.engine.resolve -> shibuya.engine.state_ledger",
  "shibuya.llm -> shibuya.llm.fleet",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.classical -> shibuya.llm.mock",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.decision.layer -> shibuya.engine.commit",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.decision.layer -> shibuya.engine.tools.registry",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.familiarity -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.memory -> shibuya.engine.commit",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.memory -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.store_memory -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.wom -> shibuya.engine.poi_target",
  "shibuya.mind.plan.contact_port -> shibuya.llm.mock",
  "shibuya.society.speech.layer -> shibuya.llm.mock",
  "shibuya.society.speech.layer -> shibuya.mind.memory.wom",
  "shibuya.world.body.rules -> shibuya.engine.change_detect",
  "shibuya.world.model.geometry -> shibuya.engine.change_detect",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "〔段 4 の途中の決まり〕2 foundation は何も読まない"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
  "shibuya.foundation",
]
forbidden_modules = [
  "shibuya.world.laws",
  "shibuya.mind",
  "shibuya.act",
  "shibuya.society",
  "shibuya.world.body",
  "shibuya.world.model",
  "shibuya.world.things",
  "shibuya.economy",
  "shibuya.world.facts",
  "shibuya.world.ledger",
  "shibuya.build",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "〔段 4 の途中の決まり〕3 mind は foundation(と mind)だけを読む"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
  "shibuya.mind",
]
forbidden_modules = [
  "shibuya.world.laws",
  "shibuya.act",
  "shibuya.society",
  "shibuya.world.body",
  "shibuya.world.model",
  "shibuya.world.things",
  "shibuya.economy",
  "shibuya.world.facts",
  "shibuya.world.ledger",
  "shibuya.build",
]
ignore_imports = [
  "shibuya.engine.change_detect -> shibuya.world.assets",
  "shibuya.engine.change_detect -> shibuya.world.model.state",
  "shibuya.engine.events.body -> shibuya.engine.tools.record",
  "shibuya.engine.relations -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.engine.relations -> shibuya.world.model.proximity",
  "shibuya.llm -> shibuya.llm.fleet",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.classical -> shibuya.engine.calendar",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.classical -> shibuya.llm.mock",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.decision.layer -> shibuya.economy.stage2_bind",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.decision.layer -> shibuya.engine.commit",
  "shibuya.mind.judge.decision.layer -> shibuya.engine.tools.registry",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.familiarity -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.memory -> shibuya.engine.commit",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.memory -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.store_memory -> shibuya.engine.resolve",
  "shibuya.mind.memory.wom -> shibuya.engine.poi_target",
  "shibuya.mind.plan.contact_port -> shibuya.llm.mock",
  "shibuya.perception.renderer -> shibuya.world.assets",
  "shibuya.perception.renderer -> shibuya.world.model.state",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "〔段 4 の途中の決まり〕5 お金と物の書き手(`economy.ops`・`economy.goods`・`economy.ledger`)を読めるのは economy・interfaces だけ"
type = "protected"
protected_modules = [
  "shibuya.economy.ops",
  "shibuya.economy.goods",
  "shibuya.economy.ledger",
]
allowed_importers = [
  "shibuya.economy",
  "shibuya.cli",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "〔段 4 の途中の決まり〕6 economy は world.facts と foundation だけを読む"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
  "shibuya.economy",
]
forbidden_modules = [
  "shibuya.world.laws",
  "shibuya.mind",
  "shibuya.act",
  "shibuya.society",
  "shibuya.world.body",
  "shibuya.world.model",
  "shibuya.world.things",
  "shibuya.world.ledger",
  "shibuya.build",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "〔段 4 の途中の決まり〕7 society は act・mind・runtime・world.laws・interim_bundles を読まない"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
  "shibuya.society",
]
forbidden_modules = [
  "shibuya.act",
  "shibuya.mind",
  "shibuya.world.laws",
]
ignore_imports = [
  "shibuya.society.speech.layer -> shibuya.llm.mock",
  "shibuya.society.speech.layer -> shibuya.mind.memory.wom",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "〔段 4 の途中の決まり〕8 ランの側は build を読まない"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
  "shibuya.world.laws",
  "shibuya.mind",
  "shibuya.act",
  "shibuya.society",
  "shibuya.world.body",
  "shibuya.world.model",
  "shibuya.world.things",
  "shibuya.economy",
  "shibuya.world.facts",
  "shibuya.world.ledger",
  "shibuya.foundation",
]
forbidden_modules = [
  "shibuya.build",
]
